name: mcp-app-builder
description: Create, package, connect, and verify ready-to-use MCP Apps for Codex plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Create MCP Apps and ChatGPT Apps.
interface.longDescription: MCP App Builder turns a product idea into a running MCP App or a ready-to-install Codex plugin. It generates the plugin manifest, bundled stdio MCP launcher, optional backend-issued app reference, Apps SDK tool and widget metadata, and a local marketplace entry when requested, then validates the complete package.
defaultPrompt: Create a ready-to-use App for a Codex plugin.
Plan a ChatGPT App from this product idea.
Package and validate this MCP App as a Codex plugin.
